units.description: May ride a horse, or count as Riding Horses.

units.name: Beserker
units.description: May ride a horse, or count as Riding Horses. Up to four Hirdmen bases may be upgraded to include a Beserker. No more than one of these may be included in a single unit, and no more than one commander in total may be present in a Viking unit.  If the unit containing the Beserker loses a roundof combat, or fails a Cohesion test, the additional attacks are lost.

units.name: Hirdmen
units.description: A Hirdmen has light armour, spear and shield. Superior Fighters. Shieldwall. May change to throwing spear (+2) or two-handed axe (+2). May be Veteran (+2). May count as Riding Horses (+1). Hirdmen and Bondi may be fielded in Open Order at a cost of 17 points and eleven points respectively.  All of the troops in a contingent must be of the same order.

units.name: Bondi
units.description: Bondi have a hand weapon, spear and shield. Shieldwall. May change to throwing spear (+2) or exchange spear and shield for bow (free).  May count as Riding Horses (+1).  Bow armed Bondi may be fielded as skirmishers instead at six points per base. Hirdmen and Bondi may be fielded in Open Order at a cost of 17 points and eleven points respectively.  All of the troops in a contingent must be of the same order.
